children: Bahrain - The SME Fund has provided BD6.125 million in financing across 114 approved applications since starting operations in March, Bahrain Development Bank (BDB) announced on the sidelines of Gateway Gulf investment forum 2026.
The results mark one year since the fund’s launch as a joint initiative between BDB, BBK, NBB, and Al Salam Bank, supported by Tamkeen and managed by BDB.

Industry and Commerce Minister and SME Fund Advisory Board chairman Abdulla bin Adel Fakhro said the results demonstrate effective collaboration under Team Bahrain. He highlighted that expanding financial access for micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs) remains vital to boosting private sector growth, economic diversification, and competitiveness.
Fund manager BDB confirmed that small enterprises secured the largest share of financing at 69 per cent, followed by medium-sized businesses at 23pc and microenterprises at 8pc.

By sector, trading activities accounted for 53pc of total funding, services represented 32pc, manufacturing took 8pc, transport and logistics received 5pc, and technology, media, and telecommunications comprised 2pc.
Green and sustainability-focused projects are targeted to receive up to 10pc of total investments, while ventures led by women and youth currently represent 18pc of the portfolio.
Additionally, the fund’s Musanada programme – run with Tamkeen from May to September to address SME liquidity needs – accounted for 14pc of all approved transactions.
BDB chairman Ghassan Abdulaal said the fund equips local businesses to pursue sustainable expansion, reinforcing the private sector’s role in long-term economic development.

Commenting on the achievements, BDB Group chief executive officer Dalal Al Qais said: “The fund’s first-year performance reflects the effectiveness of the operating model developed in collaboration with our partners, as well as the efforts to direct capital which would empower businesses to capitalise on valuable market opportunities. The results also confirm considerable demand for financing solutions that enhance their capacity for expansion and investment. We extend our sincere appreciation to all our partners for their contributions and continued co-operation throughout this journey.”
